prompt: We want a CUI enclave so our whole network isn't in CMMC scope. How does scoping work?
assertions: Uses the CMMC scoping categories: CUI assets, Security Protection Assets, Contractor Risk Managed Assets, Specialized Assets, out-of-scope — with correct treatment of each
Endorses the enclave pattern: concentrate CUI processing/storage/transmission behind a defined boundary to shrink the assessment scope
Requires CUI dataflow mapping (entry, storage, movement, exit — email, file shares, endpoints, cloud)
Covers external providers: CSPs holding CUI need FedRAMP Moderate or equivalency; ESPs/MSPs enter scope via Security Protection Asset treatment
Covers flow-down: Level 2 for subs receiving CUI, Level 1 for FCI-only subs, DFARS 7012 flows down
